usedFor: inflow-inventory holds purchase orders and Seven Time holds tasks, so “Updated Purchase Order” can run “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Purchase Order” in inflow-inventory, then “Create Task” in Seven Time
bestTemplate.why: When a purchase order changes, someone gets a Seven Time task to check it.

watchOut: “Updated Purchase Order” fires on every update, so the same order can create several tasks in Seven Time.
